svg.text: Drive AC heating and record voltage harmonics

g.text: Thermal / electrical acquisition; no experimental trace or image generated

svg.text: Inputs: Deposit aluminum lines through a shadow mask; Prepare the matched dielectric-on-Si reference; Fit line
Output state: Drive AC heating and record voltage harmonics
After: Fit line resistance versus calibration temperature
Source scope: Drive AC current through the Al line as heater, and use the third harmonic voltage as
thermometer signal. Methods list Keithley 6221 current source and Stanford Research Systems SR830 lock-in
for first and third harmonics; current amplitude and frequency are not reported.
Illustration scope: Conceptual acquisition diagram. Instrument internals, beam paths and specimen drawing
dimensions are not measured geometry; source results are shown separately.
Source: Main PDF p.8, Thermal Conductivity Measurement; Main PDF p.7, Materials and Equipment
